name: luna-shopper-backend-gateway
comment: Runtime dependency manifest for the container image. Development uses the single root package.json (plan 0003); this is the authoritative list of what the built service needs at runtime, so `nx prune` produces a pruned package.json + lockfile for a reproducible `npm ci` in the Dockerfile (plan 0002, section 3). Includes the deps the bundled @portfolio/luna-shopper/platform code pulls in (pino/terminus/swagger/throttler/class-validator, and the OpenTelemetry SDK that `main.ts` loads before anything else). @nestjs/jwt is here because the guest participant guard verifies zone tokens in the gateway itself, and multer because the bundle requires it at top level; multer resolved by hoisting through @nestjs/platform-express, which pins an older version, so it is named here rather than left to luck. Keep in sync with the imports the service actually uses, and check the built main.js rather than the source when a dependency looks unused.
